definition_comparable_page_pair: A tool's pricing page that carried readable amounts in the first month's capture and was read again in the second month's capture.

change_types.restructure: the plan ladder was rebuilt (tiers added, removed or renamed with new amounts)
change_types.withdrawn: a published price was taken off the page

rounds.excluded_and_why: Currency selectors (Rank Math $118 → €118, FullEnrich €720 → $720 — same digits, different setting on the page). Captures that failed (Freshservice returned four lines in July and nine in August, one of them raw Next.js JSON). Annual rates shown for the first time (Beehiiv, VidPal). A feature change with no price change (Leadpages went from 500 pages to unlimited; its '13-year track record' also became '14-year'). Promotional churn (Hostinger). Amounts that were never prices — Emergent's pricing page was announcing a $130M Series C. Too small to bother reporting (Notify Me, $9.99 → $9.90). And six where two captures weren't enough to tell what had happened (Flippa, Kartra, Aspire, Pangram, Trainerize, ZenZap). One more I held back at first: UENI clearly restructured, but my own notes on it were a month out of date, and publishing would have contradicted my own writeup. I re-read the page in a browser, corrected the notes from one subscription to four tiers, and it's in the list above.

Sixty-two pages where amounts were only added or removed, not changed (new annual rates shown, a tier's card no longer captured). BuddyPunch: the capture shows two rate rows side by side and, without a browser, we cannot tell which row is annual and which is monthly, so a possible second increase stays unreported until we read the page live. Glide: the August capture caught only the add-on lines, so there is nothing to compare. Hostinger: promotional churn, all three renewal rates unchanged. Amounts identical with different formatting (Leadfeeder, Housecall Pro, Calilio, KrispCall, Compliancely, Heard, UENI). Amounts that were never prices (Printify's page shows an $813 order example; Vida AI's a $1,500 pilot). Too small to report (Notify Me).

Twenty-two of the forty candidates were not price changes. Lines caught in one month and not the other, with the plan prices themselves unchanged (Apollo, BrowserAct, Calilio, CometChat, MeetGeek, Post Purchase Upsell Hero, Sentaro, Storista, Signal House, Pangram). Gorgias: the comparison table's AI overage rates ($1.00, $0.90, $0.85) entered the capture while the cards' $1.50 line left it; both were already on the page, plan prices unchanged. Postscript: a new $699 plan appeared beside the unchanged $0, $100 and $500 plans; the other new figures are the carriers' average fees, not Postscript's. Currency or storefront, not price (Campaign Monitor, SimplyBook.me in reais, Zendesk served from its German site in euros). WP Rocket: rounding. Cloudways: a broken capture. Promotions with the regular price unchanged (ChemiCloud, Heard, TaxCycle, Surfer, and FreshBooks, whose 90% off for three months became $1 a month for a year on Lite and 80% off for three months on Plus and Premium, regular $23, $43 and $70 unchanged). Two of the forty did not come from the comparison of amounts: Expertise AI and Momence carried amounts in September and none in October, which the diff cannot flag, and both turned out to be withdrawn prices. The other two pages in that check, Pippit and VWO, are capture failures: one renders its prices in the browser, the other now redirects to its parent company's site. Twenty pages where amounts were only added and fifteen where they were only removed were not read as candidates.

Ninety of the 119 candidates (113 pages whose amounts changed and 6 whose amounts disappeared) were not price changes, or could not be confirmed. Lines caught in one month and not the other, with the plan prices themselves unchanged (Aircall, Algomo, Bizee, BrowserAct, Chatwith, Checkr, Disputifier, Feedyio, Hive, Kinsta, KrispCall, Leadfeeder, Melio, Reditus, Replit, Signal House, SmartSuite, SupaEasy, Survicate, Thordata, Toggl, Typewise, Warmup Inbox, Webflow, ZenBusiness, xTiles). Pangram's 'new' Team plan was already there in September at the same $20 a seat; bOnline's October capture caught a single amount, too little to compare; Bold Memberships' $0.13 per member is still on the page. Same amounts, different wording or layout (BuddyPunch shows $2 a month as $24 a year; Frase, Gorgias, Sellfy, SocialBee; Seller Snap fixed a typo in its savings line; Sunsama's FAQ was corrected to match card prices that never moved; Influencer Hero now invoices every six months instead of quarterly at the same monthly rates). Assembly added a $2,000 starting price for its custom plan beside unchanged plans. Currency or storefront, not price (Aspire served its Singapore page, Birch and Wati switched to euros, Claap added dollars beside euros, InVideo switched to euros, Zeffy served its German page). Annual and monthly views that cannot be lined up (Beehiiv, FineVoice, Leadpages, PostOnce, WP Rocket). Promotions with the regular price unchanged (Atlas AI Store Builder, Atria's Black Friday strikethroughs, BookX, Database Mart, doola, ElevenLabs, FreshBooks, Hostinger, Kit, LifterLMS, Rank Math, Retouch4me, Sender, Shore, Timesact Preorder). Rounding (Leavo, $2.49 to $2.50). Amounts that were never plan prices (Calilio's bundle values and one destination's per-minute rate, Sendcloud's shipping examples, Superfiliate, and Tapita AI SEO Blog Builder and Tapita SEO Optimizer, whose only amount was '$0.00 USD'). Bare amounts with no label to tie them to (Oneflow, Passpack, ServiceM8, Shopmonkey, UpsellPlus, WhisperTranscribe). Broken captures or redirects (Beefree now lands on reallygoodemails.com, Freshservice, Proton and Proton Drive returned binary noise, Readymode moved between test pages, Woodpecker renders its prices in the browser, accessiBe's capture moved to a different page while accessWidget's own prices are unchanged). And seven where we could not confirm what the captures suggest: Fast Bundle's $299 plan was missing on 2 November but back on the live page on 8 November; CallHippo's rate read $0.23 a minute in the capture and $0.29 live; Lindy.ai's entry seat read $29.99 in the capture and $49.99 live, which we will read again next round; Heard's rendered page shows old and new prices side by side; BabyLoveGrowth is still testing its prices and its annual Scale figure does not add up; SalesTarget.ai's top plan moved from $679 to $639 but now sits on a new volume selector, so the two figures may not be for the same volume; and the discountkit.app page we capture for Code Bulk Discounts dropped its $49.99 tier, but our dossier prices the product from its Shopify listing, so we could not tie that page to the product. Blinq, Bread & Butter, Flocksy and Omniseo are in the list although their existing prices held: each added a priced plan that was absent in September, in October and in our own notes. A new priced plan added next to plans whose prices did not move, which round 3 also left out (Postscript): Blinq, Bread & Butter, Flocksy, Omniseo.
